title: Add server-set Chat.activeCallAccountId and set it with activeCallId
description:
Spec sync to jmap-chat-spec 63e9d08 (diff 0cd3af0..63e9d08). Oracle: the quoted spec text at 63e9d08.

[chat-core] Add server-set Chat.activeCallAccountId and set it with activeCallId
Spec (57243ea): draft-atwood-jmap-chat-00.md L656-657: "`activeCallAccountId` (Id|null, server-set): The id of the account hosting the VTCCall named by `activeCallId`, so a client can join a call held in another account. The server sets and clears this field together with `activeCallId`, in the same state change: it is non-null exactly when `activeCallId` is non-null. Like `activeCallId`, it is not a `Chat/set` patch key."
Code: crate-jmap-chat-types/src/chat.rs:223-228 (only active_call_id; no active_call_account_id); crate-jmap-chat-types/src/chat.rs:296 (constructor default); crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:149-181 sync_active_call_id (patches only "activeCallId"; takes a single account_id with no VTC hosting-account parameter); crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/chat_server_set_fields.rs:60-79 (patch-rejection test covers closedAt/activeCallId only)
Now: Chat has no activeCallAccountId property, so Chat/get never returns it. sync_active_call_id writes only activeCallId. Chat/set already rejects unknown keys through the CHAT_UPDATE_ALLOWED allowlist (crate-jmap-chat-server/src/chat.rs:63), so the no-patch rule holds automatically.
Change: Add `#[serde(default)] pub active_call_account_id: Option<Id>` (serializes null) to Chat. In sync_active_call_id, take the VTCCall's hosting account id and patch activeCallId and activeCallAccountId together in one update_object call: both set on active, both null on ended. Add test coverage for activeCallAccountId patch rejection and for paired set/clear.

[vtc] Set Chat.activeCallAccountId alongside activeCallId
Spec (77984ff): draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00.md L159: "**Active call banner** is signaled via the `activeCallId` and `activeCallAccountId` fields on Chat (see {{JMAP-CHAT}})."; L2028: "a call created with a `chatId` would also set that Chat's `activeCallId` and `activeCallAccountId`"
Code: crate-jmap-chat-vtc-server/src/lib.rs:149-181
Now: sync_active_call_id patches only activeCallId. No crate defines activeCallAccountId (grep finds nothing, including jmap-chat-types).
Change: Patch activeCallAccountId to the call's hosting account when setting activeCallId, and to null when clearing it. This depends on Chat gaining the field in jmap-chat-types, which the chat-draft workflow owns.
